exposure: body mass index (BMI) at the end of the pregnancy <30 kg/m(2)
cohort: All deliveries from January 2011 to December 2017 in a single Italian university hospital
finding: Epidural analgesia, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, vaginal nonoperative birth, vacuum extraction, pushing stage ≥60 minutes, and perineal tear were identified as major independent risk factors for PPUR, while non-Caucasian ethnicity, nulliparity, and a BMI <30 kg/m(2) at the end of pregnancy were minor risk factors.
mod_finding: Compared to Cesarean section, nonoperative vaginal birth and vacuum extraction were significant risk factors for postpartum urinary retention.
